card.name: Developing-world and global comparisons
card.fires_on: Small words like in, for, as, and 's, or the word developing, right before a mention of developing countries, the world, or Africa. It fires in global-health, energy and population passages.

modes.label: Word 'developing'
modes.description: The word developing itself, just before countries, nations or world.
modes.example: So, most of the growth is occurring in<< developing>> countries.

modes.label: Linking word before world/countries
modes.description: A small word such as in, 's or for that leads into the developing world or the whole world.
modes.example: A major killer<< in>> the developing world, particularly Africa, where

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with Africa, countries, global, or worldwide terms.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to talk about developing countries, Africa, or the world as a whole.
